dissonance: Restarting after a game ends behaves the same, but the 'Play Again' button and Space shortcut now re-run a single consolidated reset, so a new game always starts from a clean ball, paddles and score; nothing visible should change, apart from any stale state from the previous game no longer carrying over.

metric.name: play_again_click
metric.description: Counts how often players click the Play Again button (or press Space) after the game-over screen is shown, divided by how many times the game-over screen was shown.
